description:
Adds the category rules of the lane kernel and the lane transposition to the committed profile summarizer.

## Background

The profile of `dev/active/3be770d5` attributes the single-frame decoder's time to categories by source span and records counter groups at one, six, twelve and twenty-four workers. Its series runs a profiling executable under a session script, each session under its own host acquisition, and its summarizer resolves each sample to a category. The lane route widens the decoder workspace eightfold per worker, so cache traffic is the limit the counters test. The summarizer `dev/active/3be770d5/survey/summarize-profile.py` assigns a sample to a category by the source span of its inline chain, through its `LOCATION_RULES` table; a span no rule covers falls into an uncategorized remainder. The lane kernels and the batch decoder's transposition are source spans the table does not name.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The `LOCATION_RULES` table names categories for the lane check step, the lane variable step, the lane transposition in and out and the lane syndrome, by source span of the pinned files.
- [hard] REQ-02: The committed profile summaries of the earlier series regenerate byte for byte.
- [hard] REQ-03: The summarizer's self-test passes and covers a sample in each added category.
title: Categorize lane kernel samples in the profile summarizer
